newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul mulls raising Korea Fund capital by $200 mln.
newsitem.headline: Seoul mulls raising Korea Fund capital by $200 mln.

text.p: South Korea is considering raising the Korea Fund's capital by $200 million to $580 million in the first quarter of next year, finance ministry officials said on Wednesday.
"We are considering expanding the fund's capital, but a final decision has yet to be made," said a senior official, who asked not to be named.
Korea Fund was set up and listed on the New York stock exchange in 1984.
Another ministry official said the move was aimed at boosting the base for foreign investment in the domestic stock market, which has been languishing due to liquidity shortages.
